c067177425b2.en: IDL115 · CSIE3544AB · National Dong Hwa University, Dept. of Computer Science & Engineering · Academic Year 115, Semester 1

996e68a6805d.zh:
Instructor: "Welcome to Introductory Deep Learning! Over the next 17 weeks we'll go from a single artificial neuron all the way to the models behind ChatGPT and Midjourney. Today: how this course runs, and a 30,000-foot view of the whole field."
「歡迎來到深度學習導論！接下來 17 週，我們會從一顆人工神經元，一路講到 ChatGPT 和 Midjourney 背後的模型。今天：這門課怎麼玩，還有整個領域的空拍鳥瞰圖。」
996e68a6805d.en: Instructor: "Welcome to Introductory Deep Learning! Over the next 17 weeks we'll go from a single artificial neuron all the way to the models behind ChatGPT and Midjourney. Today: how this course works, and a bird's-eye view of the whole field."

76396607e9e3.zh:
Student: "I've heard deep learning is basically magic and math at the same time. Which one is this course?"
「聽說深度學習又像魔法又像數學，這門課到底是哪一種？」
76396607e9e3.en: Student: "I've heard deep learning is like magic and like math at the same time. So which one is this course?"

f2e9c8120f6d.zh:
Instructor: "Both — but the magic only feels like magic until you see the math underneath. That's the whole point of this semester."
「兩者都是——只是魔法在你看到底層數學之前，才會一直感覺像魔法。這正是這學期的重點。」
f2e9c8120f6d.en: Instructor: "Both — but the magic only feels like magic until you see the math underneath. That's the whole point of this semester."

e02e704d8aa5.zh: 3What You'll Be Able to Do | 課程目標

01c574a3d7d0.zh: 🧮Explain neural networks, backprop, and gradient descent from first principles | 從第一原理解釋類神經網路、反向傳播與梯度下降
01c574a3d7d0.en: 🧮Explain neural networks, backpropagation, and gradient descent from first principles

fd586b43566f.zh: ⚖️Compare optimizers and regularizers, and reason about training stability vs. generalization | 比較最佳化與正則化方法，權衡訓練穩定度與泛化能力
fd586b43566f.en: ⚖️Compare optimization and regularization methods, and weigh training stability against generalization

db22940b60fe.zh: 🐍Implement and train CNNs and RNN/LSTM models, all in PyTorch | 用 PyTorch 實作並訓練 CNN、RNN／LSTM 模型
db22940b60fe.en: 🐍Implement and train CNN and RNN/LSTM models in PyTorch

21e544498dad.zh: 🎯Explain self-attention and why Transformers outperform RNNs on long sequences | 解釋自注意力機制，以及 Transformer 為何在長序列上優於 RNN
21e544498dad.en: 🎯Explain the self-attention mechanism, and why Transformers outperform RNNs on long sequences

d548c6971249.zh: 🎨Build simple generative models (VAE, GAN) and judge their output quality | 實作簡易生成模型（VAE、GAN）並評估生成品質
d548c6971249.en: 🎨Implement simple generative models (VAE, GAN) and evaluate the quality of what they generate

fb5bf6dad571.zh: 👥As a team, design, train, and present a complete deep-learning project | 以團隊協作方式設計、訓練並發表一個完整的深度學習專題
fb5bf6dad571.en: 👥As a team, design, train, and present a complete deep-learning project

75e17b1e3e82.zh: Final Exam + Project (Wk 17) | 期末考＋專題

822b8d7ca151.zh: 5Assignments & Final Project | 作業與期末專題

4e4cf4fe7ca1.zh: HW1 · Backprop & MLP (Wk 3 → Wk 6) | 反向傳播與 MLP

372c52939521.zh: Hand-code a 2-layer MLP's forward/backward pass in NumPy and verify it with gradient checking. | 用 NumPy 手刻兩層 MLP 的前向／反向傳播，並以梯度檢查驗證正確性。
372c52939521.en: Hand-code the forward and backward passes of a two-layer MLP in NumPy, and verify they are correct with gradient checking.

4e5d41b8990b.zh: HW2 · CNN Image Classification (Wk 8 → Wk 11) | CNN 影像分類

87b8fd95ede4.zh: Train a CNN on CIFAR-10 in PyTorch; compare at least two regularization strategies. | 用 PyTorch 於 CIFAR-10 訓練 CNN，比較至少兩種正則化策略。
87b8fd95ede4.en: Train a CNN on CIFAR-10 in PyTorch and compare at least two regularization strategies.

7e535f21afe0.zh: HW3 · Sequences & Attention (Wk 12 → Wk 15) | 序列建模與注意力

d335ff3d92a1.zh: Solve a sequence task with LSTM/GRU or a simplified self-attention model, with a short write-up. | 用 LSTM/GRU 或簡化版自注意力完成序列任務，並撰寫實驗報告。
d335ff3d92a1.en: Complete a sequence task with an LSTM/GRU or a simplified self-attention model, and write an experiment report.

80a9ed219a03.zh: Final Project — Team-based (Wk 10 → Wk 17) | 期末專題——分組進行

1c097ecfd483.zh: Teams of 3–4 (1–2 also fine if needed) pick their own topic from anything taught in this course — required or elective units alike. | 建議每組 3–4 人（有困難 1–2 人亦可），主題由各組依興趣自訂，範圍為本課程所有教授過的單元（必授＋選讀皆可）。
1c097ecfd483.en: Teams of 3–4 people are recommended (1–2 is also fine if that's hard to manage). Each team picks its own topic based on its interests, from any unit taught in this course (required or elective).

941bb884106e.zh: 6AI Assistance + GitHub: The Rules | AI 輔助與 GitHub：遊戲規則
941bb884106e.en: 6AI Assistance & GitHub: The Rules of the Game

aa234b626466.zh: You may use any AI tool for every assignment and the final project — including an AI agent that runs git commit and git push for you. The one non-negotiable: your own thinking has to be visible in the repo. | 所有作業與期末專題都可以使用任何 AI 工具——甚至可以請 AI agent 直接幫你執行 git commit 與 git push。唯一不能少的是：你自己的思考過程必須看得見。
aa234b626466.en: You may use any AI tool for every assignment and the final project — you can even have an AI agent run git commit and git push for you. The one thing that can't be missing: your own thinking process has to be visible.

8233768d81c1.zh: 📝 Required Commit Message Format | 必要的 Commit 訊息格式

a749d4f2cd38.zh: ✅Many small, incremental commits — not one giant final commit | 多次漸進式 commit，不要一次性上傳完成品
a749d4f2cd38.en: ✅Many small, incremental commits — don't upload the finished product in one go

7f8018ffeffd.zh: 🤖Fine to let an AI agent write & push the commit — as long as it shows you the message first for your OK | 可以讓 AI agent 代寫並推送 commit，但須先列出完整訊息讓你確認
7f8018ffeffd.en: 🤖You may let an AI agent write and push commits for you, but it must first show you the full message for your approval

30523390d50f.zh: 🔎You may be asked, at random, to explain any commit in your own words | 教師可能隨機抽問，請你用自己的話解釋任一次 commit
30523390d50f.en: 🔎The instructor may pick a commit at random and ask you to explain it in your own words

4ee045e2221f.zh: 7Final Project Delivery | 期末專題交付方式

d302cb81bd32.zh: 8–12 min, unlisted on YouTube. Structure: motivation → method → results/demo → conclusion. Link submitted via the e-course system. | 8–12 分鐘，YouTube 設為「不公開」。結構：動機 → 方法 → 結果／demo → 結論。連結繳交至 e 學苑。
d302cb81bd32.en: 8–12 minutes, set to “Unlisted” on YouTube. Structure: motivation → method → results/demo → conclusion. Submit the link through the e-course system.

f5298fd0c580.zh: Lives inside your GitHub repo (e.g. report.md). The repo must be switched to Public by the deadline. | 報告直接寫在 GitHub repo 中（如 report.md），截止前 repo 須設為 Public（公開）。
f5298fd0c580.en: Write the report directly in your GitHub repo (e.g. report.md). The repo must be set to Public before the deadline.

115f7152da3e.zh: Repo still Private after the deadline = project counted as not submitted. No late exceptions. | 逾期 repo 仍為 Private，一律視同未繳交，不受理補交。
115f7152da3e.en: If the repo is still Private after the deadline, the project is treated as not submitted, no exceptions. Late submissions are not accepted.

ebd609ba885f.zh: Week 17 in class is exam only — no presentations. Everyone watches each other's videos and browses each other's repos on their own time, after grades close. | 第 17 週課堂只有期末考，不排期末專題發表；大家在課後自行上網看彼此的影片、瀏覽彼此的 repo。
ebd609ba885f.en: In Week 17 the class session is the final exam only; no final-project presentations are scheduled. Everyone watches each other's videos and browses each other's repos online on their own time, outside class.

9e8cb3dea898.zh: Can my final-project topic go beyond what's taught in class? | 期末專題可以做超出課堂教過的題目嗎？ ▼
9e8cb3dea898.en: Can my final-project topic go beyond what's taught in class? ▼

294d284225c8.zh: Yes — as long as it's covered by this course's 22 lecture chapters (required or elective). Topics with zero coverage anywhere in the course materials are discouraged, so you always have material and theory to fall back on. | 可以——只要屬於本課程 22 章講義涵蓋範圍（必授或選讀皆可）。完全超出這 22 章之外、教材空白的全新主題則不建議，以確保你仍有講義與理論可依循。
294d284225c8.en: Yes — as long as it falls within this course's 22 lecture-note chapters (required or elective). Brand-new topics completely outside these 22 chapters, with no course material behind them, are not recommended, so that you still have lecture notes and theory to rely on.

9e5bb4b11b99.zh: What if my group only has 1 or 2 people? | 如果我這組只有 1、2 個人怎麼辦？ ▼
9e5bb4b11b99.en: What if my group only has 1 or 2 people? ▼

9d24b9b9ac24.zh: Totally fine. 3–4 is the sweet spot, but 1–2 person teams are explicitly allowed. | 完全沒問題，3–4 人是建議人數，但 1–2 人一組也是被明確允許的。
9d24b9b9ac24.en: No problem at all. 3–4 people is the recommended team size, but teams of 1–2 are explicitly allowed.

1dc4c1f0a2d2.zh: Do I need a server to submit the final report? | 繳交期末報告需要架設伺服器嗎？ ▼
1dc4c1f0a2d2.en: Do I need to set up a server to submit the final report? ▼

8f6cce626f01.zh: No — just a public GitHub repo. The instructor opens it directly in a browser, no login or clone required. | 不需要——只要一個公開的 GitHub repo。教師直接用瀏覽器開啟即可，不需登入或 clone。
8f6cce626f01.en: No — just a public GitHub repo. The instructor opens it directly in a browser; no login or clone needed.

6f7d3af4901b.zh: Part B · What Is Deep Learning, Anyway? | 深度學習到底是什麼
6f7d3af4901b.en: Part B · What Is Deep Learning, Anyway?

3d84711944ba.zh: 9A Model Is a Map, Not the Territory | 模型是地圖，不是地圖所指的實地
3d84711944ba.en: 9A Model Is the Map, Not the Territory

c0c0f5dc21b3.zh: — on model usefulness | 關於模型有沒有用
c0c0f5dc21b3.en: — on whether a model is useful

ded435869c5f.zh: A good model doesn't have to be "true" — it has to be useful: it explains past data and predicts future data. | 好模型不必然要「為真」——它必須有用：解釋過去的觀測，並預測未來的觀測。
ded435869c5f.en: A good model doesn't necessarily have to be “true” — it has to be useful: it explains past observations and predicts future ones.

f05de754479a.zh: The map (model) is a simplified, useful representation — never the real terrain (the world) itself. | 地圖（模型）是簡化但有用的表示法——它終究不是真正的地形（真實世界）本身。
f05de754479a.en: The map (the model) is a simplified but useful representation — in the end, it is not the actual terrain (the real world) itself.

199a78fd9421.zh: The 3-Step Machine Learning Recipe | 機器學習三步驟食譜

2ff45e4b8ba0.zh: "Propose a modeling hypothesis, then use data to test and correct it" — echoing Karl Popper's philosophy of science. | 「先提出一個建模假設，再用資料去檢驗、修正它」——呼應 Popper 的科學哲學。
2ff45e4b8ba0.en: “First propose a modeling hypothesis, then use data to test and revise it” — echoing Popper's philosophy of science.

a8891c632a1c.zh: What kind of model? Linear, tree-based, neural network... | 定義建模類型：線性、樹、神經網路……
a8891c632a1c.en: Define the type of model: linear, tree, neural network...

54d31f2f8895.zh: A number that quantifies how bad a model is. | 用損失函數量化模型好壞。
54d31f2f8895.en: Use a loss function to quantify how good or bad a model is.

301e25cb9273.zh: Solve an optimization problem to find the lowest-loss model. | 求解最佳化問題，找出損失最低的模型。
301e25cb9273.en: Solve an optimization problem to find the model with the lowest loss.

bebb670cd0fa.zh: "Find the function $f$, out of an allowed family $\mathcal{F}$, that minimizes the score $S(f)$." | 「在一個允許的函數家族 $\mathcal{F}$ 中，找出讓評分 $S(f)$ 最小的那個函數 $f$。」
bebb670cd0fa.en: “Within an allowed family of functions $\mathcal{F}$, find the function $f$ that minimizes the score $S(f)$.”

3cc6ccbc42d3.zh: No Free Lunch: no learning algorithm beats all others on every possible problem — unless it first assumes something about the world (an inductive bias). | 沒有免費午餐定理：沒有任何學習演算法能在所有問題上都表現最好——除非它先對世界做了假設（歸納偏置）。
3cc6ccbc42d3.en: No Free Lunch theorem: no learning algorithm performs best on every problem — unless it first makes assumptions about the world (an inductive bias).

ed4b9c3e8b06.zh: 10Turning the World Into Vectors | 把世界變成向量

8f884a982883.zh: Every object is described by $d$ features → a $d$-dimensional vector $\boldsymbol{x}_i \in \mathbb{R}^d$; $n$ samples stack into a matrix $\boldsymbol{X} \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times n}$. | 每個物件用 $d$ 個特徵描述，變成一個 $d$ 維向量 $\boldsymbol{x}_i \in \mathbb{R}^d$；$n$ 個樣本排成矩陣 $\boldsymbol{X} \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times n}$。
8f884a982883.en: Each object is described by $d$ features and becomes a $d$-dimensional vector $\boldsymbol{x}_i \in \mathbb{R}^d$; $n$ samples are arranged into a matrix $\boldsymbol{X} \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times n}$.

90f276894ecb.zh: Measure each property, write it as a vector, then stack many vectors into the data matrix $\boldsymbol{X}$. | 先量測每個屬性、寫成向量，再將多個樣本向量堆疊成資料矩陣 $\boldsymbol{X}$。
90f276894ecb.en: First measure each property and write it as a vector, then stack many sample vectors into the data matrix $\boldsymbol{X}$.

6928c053d65c.zh: A learning model is just a function from data-space to output-space, with learnable parameters $\theta$. | 學習模型就是一個從資料空間映射到輸出空間的函數，帶有可學習的參數 $\theta$。
6928c053d65c.en: A learning model is just a function that maps the data space to the output space, with learnable parameters $\theta$.

a32aa9de52d8.zh: 11Three Flavors of Learning | 三種學習方式

d1dd9c805bfb.zh: Same data, three different jobs: sort it (supervised), group it (unsupervised), or learn from a reward signal (reinforcement). | 同樣的資料，三種不同任務：分類標記（監督式）、自動分組（非監督式），或從獎勵訊號中學習（強化學習）。
d1dd9c805bfb.en: Same data, three different tasks: label it into classes (supervised), group it automatically (unsupervised), or learn from a reward signal (reinforcement learning).

ff2e83e92522.zh: Framework anatomy: inputs and feedback determine the learning problem. | 框架解剖：輸入與回饋決定學習問題。
ff2e83e92522.en: Anatomy of the framework: the inputs and the feedback determine the learning problem.

3bcb19f0d812.zh:
Classification: $f_\theta: \mathbb{R}^d \to \{\ell_1,\dots,\ell_m\}$ — discrete labels. | 分類：離散標籤。
Regression: $f_\theta: \mathbb{R}^d \to \mathbb{R}$ — a continuous value. | 回歸：連續數值。

4d9f42bd8dd3.zh: Clustering (no labels) and dimensionality reduction $f_\theta: \mathbb{R}^d \to \mathbb{R}^p,\ p \ll d$. | 分群（無標籤）與降維。

cdbb2d79b527.zh: An agent interacts with an environment, choosing actions $a \in \mathcal{A}$ to maximize cumulative reward. Think AlphaGo. | 代理與環境互動，選擇動作以最大化累積獎勵，例如 AlphaGo。
cdbb2d79b527.en: An agent interacts with an environment, choosing actions $a \in \mathcal{A}$ to maximize the cumulative reward. Example: AlphaGo.

18305973bdec.zh: 12Classification vs. Regression | 分類 vs. 回歸

06b65fc79533.zh: Finite label set $\{\ell_1,\dots,\ell_m\}$ | 有限標籤集合

b5d4eb55a351.zh: Any real number $\mathbb{R}$ | 任意實數

4ef476cb3780.zh: Apple vs. cucumber | 蘋果 vs. 小黃瓜

f78832d09475.zh: Predicting an apple's diameter | 預測蘋果直徑

d7e71a62297c.zh: Six classic statistical families — Bayes/Naive Bayes, LDA/QDA, Logistic Regression, KNN, Decision Trees/Random Forests, and (kernel) SVM — all predate deep learning and still matter as baselines. | 統計分類的六大經典家族——Bayes／Naive Bayes、LDA／QDA、羅吉斯迴歸、KNN、決策樹／隨機森林、（核）SVM——都早於深度學習出現，至今仍是重要的基準方法。
d7e71a62297c.en: The six classic families of statistical classification (Bayes/Naive Bayes, LDA/QDA, logistic regression, KNN, decision trees/random forests, and (kernel) SVM) all predate deep learning and are still important baselines today.

d30e6c4d59ac.zh: 13Clustering vs Dimension Reduction | 分群 vs. 降維

da7a24673a77.zh: Clustering partitions points into groups; dimensionality reduction preserves their structure using fewer coordinates. | 分群將資料點劃分為群組；降維則以較少座標保留資料的結構。
da7a24673a77.en: Clustering partitions data points into groups; dimensionality reduction preserves the structure of the data using fewer coordinates.

79d7f1b81256.zh: 14Early Neural Network History (1943–1969) | 早期神經網路史

f2bb2fbe960c.zh: The first mathematical model of a neuron: binary inputs, threshold logic — could express AND/OR/NOT. | 首個神經元數學模型：二元輸入、閾值邏輯，能表達 AND/OR/NOT。
f2bb2fbe960c.en: The first mathematical model of a neuron: binary inputs and threshold logic, able to express AND/OR/NOT.

e7aece3253e1.zh: "Cells that fire together, wire together." Weights adjust by correlation — an early form of learning. | 「一起激發的細胞，會連在一起。」依相關性調整權重，是學習的雛形。
e7aece3253e1.en: “Cells that fire together, wire together.” Weights are adjusted according to correlation, an early prototype of learning.

666d71a1af74.zh: A single neuron that learns from examples — a linear classifier. | 能從範例學習的單層神經元，是線性分類器。
666d71a1af74.en: A single-layer neuron that can learn from examples; it is a linear classifier.

fbc688b961e9.zh: Minsky & Papert prove the Perceptron can't solve XOR — triggering the first AI winter for neural nets. | Minsky 與 Papert 證明感知器無法解 XOR，引發神經網路的第一次寒冬。
fbc688b961e9.en: Minsky & Papert prove that the perceptron cannot solve XOR, triggering the first winter for neural networks.

51813b893a8f.zh: From One Neuron to a Universe of Them | 從一個神經元到一整片神經網路
51813b893a8f.en: From One Neuron to an Entire Neural Network

31590abcd31c.zh: From a single McCulloch–Pitts neuron (1943) to today's massive deep networks — the same basic idea, scaled up across eight decades. | 從一顆 McCulloch–Pitts 神經元（1943）到今日龐大的深度網路——同樣的基本想法，橫跨八十年不斷擴大規模。
31590abcd31c.en: From a single McCulloch–Pitts neuron (1943) to today's massive deep networks: the same basic idea, steadily scaled up over eight decades.

1557e9f3dfb7.zh: 15Modern History: From Winter to Deep Learning Boom | 現代史：從寒冬到全面爆發
1557e9f3dfb7.en: 15Modern History: From Winter to Full-Blown Boom

d9cf81049938.zh: Vanishing/exploding gradients, weak hardware, small datasets — SVMs and kernel methods dominate instead. | 梯度消失／爆炸、硬體算力不足、資料集太小——SVM 與核方法成為主流。
d9cf81049938.en: Vanishing/exploding gradients, too little computing power, datasets too small — SVMs and kernel methods become the mainstream.

821b14362b8d.zh: 2006 · Deep Belief Networks (Hinton) | DBN 復興
821b14362b8d.en: 2006 · Deep Belief Networks (Hinton): the DBN Revival

843963cfcc48.zh: Unsupervised layer-wise pretraining finally makes deep nets trainable again. | 無監督逐層預訓練，讓深度網路重新變得可訓練。
843963cfcc48.en: Unsupervised layer-wise pretraining makes deep networks trainable again.

942d2431476b.zh: GPUs + ReLU + big data crush the ImageNet benchmark — and deep learning explodes. | GPU＋ReLU＋大數據刷新 ImageNet 成績——深度學習全面熱潮由此點燃。
942d2431476b.en: GPUs + ReLU + big data set a new record on ImageNet — and this sparks the full-blown deep learning boom.

b471513c02f4.zh: 2014 · VAE & GAN | 生成模型元年
b471513c02f4.en: 2014 · VAE & GAN: Year One of Generative Models

5488772ad724.zh: Two very different ways to generate new data: variational autoencoders and adversarial networks. | 兩種截然不同的資料生成方式：變分自編碼器與對抗生成網路。
5488772ad724.en: Two radically different ways to generate data: variational autoencoders and generative adversarial networks.

93102224c68a.zh: 2017–18 · Transformer, BERT, GPT | 注意力時代
93102224c68a.en: 2017–18 · Transformer, BERT, GPT: the Age of Attention

c4e29a8f111d.zh: Self-attention replaces recurrence — the architecture behind every modern LLM. | 自注意力取代遞迴，成為所有現代大型語言模型的基礎架構。
c4e29a8f111d.en: Self-attention replaces recurrence and becomes the foundational architecture of every modern large language model.

3e47691f1709.zh: 2020–21 · DDPM & Diffusion Models | 擴散模型崛起
3e47691f1709.en: 2020–21 · DDPM & the Rise of Diffusion Models

698d8e95bffb.zh: DDPM makes iterative denoising practical for high-quality synthesis; 2021 results surpass GANs on ImageNet. | DDPM 讓逐步加噪、再學習反向去噪的高品質生成變得實用；2021 年的結果在 ImageNet 上超越 GAN。
698d8e95bffb.en: DDPM makes high-quality generation practical by gradually adding noise and then learning to reverse it through denoising; in 2021, results surpassed GANs on ImageNet.

92f2fa89bcd7.zh: 2022 · ChatGPT | 對話式生成式 AI 普及
92f2fa89bcd7.en: 2022 · ChatGPT: Conversational Generative AI Goes Mainstream

df72dc66f3e6.zh: A GPT-3.5–based conversational research preview brings generative AI to the general public at unprecedented scale. | 以 GPT-3.5 系列為基礎的對話式研究預覽，讓生成式 AI 以前所未有的規模走進大眾使用情境。
df72dc66f3e6.en: A conversational research preview built on the GPT-3.5 series brings generative AI into everyday use by the general public at an unprecedented scale.

649a1dd6a970.zh: This entire 77-year story — Perceptron to Transformer — is exactly the syllabus of this course, in order. | 這整整 77 年的故事——從感知器到 Transformer——正好就是這門課接下來的教學順序。
649a1dd6a970.en: This entire 77-year story — from the perceptron to the Transformer — is exactly the order in which this course will be taught.

a086a47ce369.zh: 16Traditional ML vs. Deep Learning: Where Features Come From | 傳統機器學習 vs. 深度學習：特徵從哪裡來？
a086a47ce369.en: 16Traditional ML vs. Deep Learning: Where Do Features Come From?

e5ccdbb25381.zh: Traditional ML asks people to decide which features to expose; deep learning learns useful internal representations from data. | 傳統機器學習由人決定要提供哪些特徵；深度學習則從資料中學得有用的內部表徵。
e5ccdbb25381.en: In traditional machine learning, people decide which features to provide; deep learning learns useful internal representations from data.

47759c4def13.zh: Same raw image, different responsibility for representation. | 相同的原始影像，但「表徵」由誰負責的方式不同。
47759c4def13.en: The same raw image, but a different answer to who is responsible for the “representation.”

d31e8ac9a890.zh: Traditional ML | 傳統機器學習

7b760dd18826.zh: Experts choose variables such as counts, ratios, texture descriptors, or domain rules; a linear model, tree, or SVM then learns the decision boundary. | 專家先選擇變數，例如計數、比例、紋理描述子或領域規則；再由線性模型、決策樹或 SVM學習決策邊界。
7b760dd18826.en: Experts first choose the variables, such as counts, ratios, texture descriptors, or domain rules; then a linear model, decision tree, or SVM learns the decision boundary.

5d2f2d781eaa.zh: Multiple layers transform raw input into increasingly task-useful representations — but people still choose the data, architecture, loss, and evaluation. | 多個網路層轉換原始輸入，逐步形成更有助於任務的內部表徵——但人仍須選擇資料、架構、損失函數與評估方式。
5d2f2d781eaa.en: Multiple network layers transform the raw input, gradually forming internal representations that are more useful for the task — but people still have to choose the data, the architecture, the loss function, and the evaluation method.

8e5d05bb7035.zh: Choose by Constraints | 依限制選擇

3ee37ad2683b.zh: Deep learning often excels on images, audio, and text with sufficient data and compute. For small tabular data or strict interpretability/latency needs, traditional methods remain strong baselines. | 深度學習常在資料與算力充足的影像、語音、文字任務表現突出；面對小型表格資料或重視可解釋性／延遲時，傳統方法仍是很強的基準。
3ee37ad2683b.en: Deep learning often stands out on image, audio, and text tasks when data and compute are plentiful; for small tabular data, or when interpretability/latency matters, traditional methods are still very strong baselines.

9e3b26f94c6c.zh: 17 weeks, 3 HW + team final project, AI use is welcome as long as your reasoning is disclosed in commits. | 17 週課程，3 次作業＋團隊期末專題，歡迎使用 AI，但需在 commit 中揭露你的思考過程。
9e3b26f94c6c.en: A 17-week course, 3 homework assignments + a team final project. AI use is welcome, but you must disclose your thought process in your commits.

fb2dd8032613.zh: ML = hypothesis class + loss + optimization. Deep learning is one (very powerful) hypothesis class. | 機器學習＝假設類別＋損失函數＋最佳化。深度學習只是其中一種（非常強大的）假設類別。
fb2dd8032613.en: Machine learning = hypothesis class + loss function + optimization. Deep learning is just one (very powerful) hypothesis class among them.

c40048ba1030.zh: Week 2: the perceptron and the multi-layer perceptron — our first real neural network. | 第 2 週：感知器與多層感知器——我們的第一個真正的神經網路。
c40048ba1030.en: Week 2: the perceptron and the multilayer perceptron — our first real neural network.

aa52db94ea7e.zh: True or false: if your final-project repo is still Private after the deadline, you can email the instructor to get an extension. | 是非題：如果期末專題的 repo 在截止後仍為 Private，可以寄信給教師要求延期補交。
aa52db94ea7e.en: True or false: if your final-project repo is still Private after the deadline, you can email the instructor and ask to submit it late.

70364cb66997.zh: False. | 錯。A repo still Private after the deadline is counted as not submitted, with no late exceptions — this is explicit in the syllabus. | 逾期仍為 Private 一律視同未繳交，不受理補交，這在課程規劃書中已明確寫明。
70364cb66997.en: False. A repo that is still Private after the deadline is always treated as not submitted, and late submissions are not accepted — this is stated explicitly in the syllabus.

4f959c517c1b.zh: The No Free Lunch theorem says a learning algorithm needs an inductive bias to beat random guessing on a specific problem. What does "inductive bias" mean here? | 沒有免費午餐定理指出，學習演算法需要歸納偏置才能在特定問題上勝過隨機猜測。這裡「歸納偏置」是什麼意思？
4f959c517c1b.en: The No Free Lunch theorem says that a learning algorithm needs an inductive bias to beat random guessing on a specific problem. What does “inductive bias” mean here?

d03bb49c4282.zh: It's the set of assumptions a model makes about the world before seeing any data — e.g. "nearby points tend to have similar labels." Without some such assumption, no algorithm can generalize better than any other, on average across all possible problems. | 是模型在看到資料之前，就對世界做的一組假設——例如「鄰近的點傾向有相似的標籤」。沒有這樣的假設，任何演算法在所有可能問題的平均表現上，都不會比其他演算法更好。
d03bb49c4282.en: It is a set of assumptions the model makes about the world before it sees any data — e.g. “nearby points tend to have similar labels.” Without such assumptions, no algorithm does better than any other when performance is averaged over all possible problems.

f722a8f1a7f8.zh: What breakthrough in 2012 is widely credited with reigniting deep learning after decades of AI winter? | 2012 年的哪一項突破，普遍被認為是重新點燃深度學習熱潮的關鍵？
f722a8f1a7f8.en: Which breakthrough in 2012 is widely regarded as the key to reigniting the deep learning boom?

be513d3844bb.zh: AlexNet — a deep CNN trained on GPUs with ReLU activations, which dramatically outperformed all prior methods on the ImageNet competition. | AlexNet——一個用 GPU 訓練、採用 ReLU 激活函數的深度 CNN，在 ImageNet 競賽中大幅超越所有先前方法。
be513d3844bb.en: AlexNet — a deep CNN trained on GPUs with ReLU activation functions, which far outperformed all previous methods in the ImageNet competition.

cecf21401dcc.zh: A curled topographic map peeling back to reveal the real forested landscape underneath | 一張捲起的等高線地圖掀開一角，露出底下真實的山林景觀
cecf21401dcc.en: A curled-up topographic map with one corner lifted, revealing the real forested mountain landscape underneath

2d953edc4aec.zh: Concrete teaching infographic: an apple is measured by redness, diameter, and mass, then encoded as a feature vector and combined with other samples into a data matrix | 具體教學資訊圖表：以蘋果的紅度、直徑與重量量測值形成特徵向量，並與其他樣本組成資料矩陣
2d953edc4aec.en: Concrete teaching infographic: an apple's measured redness, diameter, and weight form a feature vector, which is combined with other samples into a data matrix

be52b810ed0c.zh: Three panels: labeled shapes for supervised learning, self-forming clusters for unsupervised learning, and a robot navigating a maze toward a reward star for reinforcement learning | 三個面板：監督式學習的貼標籤形狀、非監督式學習的自動分群、強化學習中機器人在迷宮中尋找獎勵星星
be52b810ed0c.en: Three panels: shapes being labeled for supervised learning, automatic clustering for unsupervised learning, and a robot searching a maze for a reward star for reinforcement learning

db94fcf7f51f.zh: Information diagram of supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning frameworks | 監督式、非監督式與強化學習框架資訊圖表
db94fcf7f51f.en: Infographic of the supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning frameworks

003a2cc0cfb8.zh: Information diagram comparing clustering and dimensionality reduction: clustering assigns the same points differently when the requested number of groups m changes, while dimensionality reduction reveals a low-dimensional manifold embedded in high-dimensional space | 比較分群與降維的資訊圖表：分群會因指定群數 m 不同而對同一批資料得到不同分組；降維則揭露嵌在高維空間中的低維流形
003a2cc0cfb8.en: Infographic comparing clustering and dimensionality reduction: clustering gives different groupings of the same data depending on the specified number of clusters m, while dimensionality reduction reveals a low-dimensional manifold embedded in a high-dimensional space

0825c42900e2.zh: Teaching infographic showing one weighted-sum neuron, a shallow network of repeated neurons, and a deep network with multiple hidden layers | 教學資訊圖表：顯示一個加權和神經元、由重複神經元構成的淺層網路、以及具有多個隱藏層的深度網路
0825c42900e2.en: Teaching infographic showing a single weighted-sum neuron, a shallow network made of repeated neurons, and a deep network with multiple hidden layers

ba3334347f47.zh: Concrete comparison infographic: traditional machine learning uses human-designed edges, color, and texture features before a classifier; deep learning learns edge, part, and object representations through a neural network | 具體比較資訊圖表：傳統機器學習先由人設計邊緣、顏色與紋理特徵再分類；深度學習則透過神經網路學得邊緣、組件與物件表徵
ba3334347f47.en: Concrete comparison infographic: in traditional machine learning, people first design edge, color, and texture features and then classify; deep learning learns edge, part, and object representations through a neural network
